# Command reference

Every operation in this area, as a `metorial-admin` CLI command and as a tool on the Metorial admin MCP server (`mcp.metorial.com/mcp`). API version: `mt_2026_01_01_magnetar`. 56 CLI commands, 54 MCP tools.

- **CLI**: prefix with `metorial-admin`. Run `metorial-admin <command> --help` for every flag. Write commands also accept `--body` or `--body-file` with a JSON object.
- **MCP tool**: pass inputs in snake_case (`<provider-id>` → `provider_id`). Instance-scoped tools also accept an optional `instance_id`.
- **Effect**: `read` changes nothing; `write` creates or changes something; `destructive` deletes, revokes, archives, or runs code. Confirm destructive actions with the user first.
- **—** in a column means that interface has no equivalent. Use the alternative named in the summary, or call the API path with `metorial-admin fetch` / the `call_endpoint` tool.

## sandbox machines

| CLI command | MCP tool | Effect | Summary | Required inputs | API |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandbox machines create` | `sandbox_machines_create` | write | Create sandbox machine | --region --image-id | `POST /sandbox/machines` |
| `sandbox machines delete <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_delete` | destructive | Terminate sandbox machine | <machine-id> | `DELETE /sandbox/machines/:machineId` |
| `sandbox machines exec <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_exec` | destructive | Run a command | <machine-id> --command | `POST /sandbox/machines/:machineId/exec` |
| `sandbox machines get <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_get` | read | Get sandbox machine | <machine-id> | `GET /sandbox/machines/:machineId` |
| `sandbox machines hibernate <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_hibernate` | write | Hibernate sandbox machine | <machine-id> | `POST /sandbox/machines/:machineId/hibernate` |
| `sandbox machines list` | `sandbox_machines_list` | read | List sandbox machines |  | `GET /sandbox/machines` |
| `sandbox machines pause <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_pause` | write | Pause sandbox machine | <machine-id> | `POST /sandbox/machines/:machineId/pause` |
| `sandbox machines restart <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_restart` | write | Restart sandbox machine | <machine-id> | `POST /sandbox/machines/:machineId/restart` |
| `sandbox machines start <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_start` | write | Start sandbox machine | <machine-id> | `POST /sandbox/machines/:machineId/start` |
| `sandbox machines touch <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_touch` | write | Touch sandbox machine | <machine-id> | `POST /sandbox/machines/:machineId/touch` |
| `sandbox machines update <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_update` | write | Update sandbox machine | <machine-id> | `PATCH /sandbox/machines/:machineId` |
| `sandbox machines usage <machine-id>` | `sandbox_machines_usage` | read | List sandbox machine usage | <machine-id> | `GET /sandbox/machines/:machineId/usage` |
